title: ECI has discretion to announce bypolls any time within six months of seat falling vacant, experts say
description: At lease 14 Assembly seats, six Parliamentary seats stay vacant as ECI announces bypolls in only three; Congress slams ECI’s hurry to schedule Datia bypoll despite ongoing case over MLA’s disqualification; in Milkipur, the Opposition accused the ECI of “delay” tactics to benefit the BJP
